# KNGHT

> KNGHT is a brand worldbuilding studio in Toronto, Ontario. It builds complete brand worlds for regulated consumer businesses: clinics, dental clinics, medspas, law firms, spirits, and food and drink. A world covers the name, the rules, the voice, the site, the space, the print and the systems that run it, all written inside the rules of the category. KNGHT is a Sergio Ho studio.

KNGHT works where one wrong word can cost a licence and one weak launch can cost a year. Every world shown was built by Sergio Ho, KNGHT's founder. KNGHT still runs some of them.

## Contact

- Email: sho@knght.com
- Studio: Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Serves Ontario.
- Founder and creative director: Sergio Ho

## The seven layers

Each world is built in this order. No layer is built before Lore.

1. Lore: who you are, who you stand against, and what you are called. The brief and the codex every other layer reads from.
2. Law: what you can say, what you can charge, and how it is packaged. Offers and claims checked against your regulator.
3. Language: voice, hooks, content and ads, written to stop the scroll and pass review.
4. Map: site, search and AI visibility. Where people find your world and how they enter it.
5. Ground: the physical space. Arrival, flow, signage and the screens on your walls.
6. Artifacts: print, labels, packaging and forms. Everything a customer holds.
7. Machinery: intake, booking, follow-up and reporting, with AI doing the repetitive work inside the rules. AI is the squire, not the knight: it drafts and reminds, and a person makes the call.

## Three ways to work with KNGHT

- The Verdict (fixed fee from $3,500 CAD, scored report in 5 business days from the kickoff call, fee credited to a Build started within 60 days): a scored audit of an existing brand world. Every layer is judged against the buyer and the regulator, with a ranked fix list and the order to do it in. Every engagement starts here.
- The Build (from $25,000 CAD for a full world, single layers from $7,500 CAD): a complete world from zero, or the missing layers, delivered ready to launch.
- The Keep (from $4,500 CAD a month, ad spend and printing billed separately): KNGHT runs the world after launch, including content, signage, campaigns, new locations and new products.

## Worlds built by KNGHT's founder

- Restoration Medical (healthcare): physician-led clinics in Thornhill and Woodbridge, built across five service lines: family medicine, pain management, medical aesthetics, infusion therapy (iron infusions and IV vitamins), and rehab and recovery with physiotherapy and chiropractic care.
- Black Lotus Coffee (food and beverage): a conscious coffee brand rooted in Vietnamese tradition and modern wellness. Founded in Da Nang and now based in Toronto, importing into Canada and selling wholesale and retail.
- Castleblack Spirits (beverage alcohol): premium Jamaican rum from St. Mary, rebuilt around heritage and flavour, now sold in more than five countries.
- Toronto Beauty (aesthetics): a growing network of aesthetic nurses across the GTA, with a profile and map search for every nurse.
- [Lorelyns Gourmet Desserts](https://lorelyns.com/) (allergen-friendly food): nut free, gluten free, plant-based desserts.
- [Rum Raiders Ring](https://rumraider.com/) (beverage alcohol): premium rum RTDs and spirits, poured in bars and stores across Ontario.
- [Lisa Dang Immigration Law](https://lisadanglaw.com/) (legal services): a boutique immigration practice where every file is handled by the lawyer, start to finish.
- Wellfit Social Club (fitness and wellness): a boutique Toronto gym built around a graffiti wall, with bookings, e-commerce and local search in one brand.
- Art Colouring (creative products): colouring books that blend mindful creativity with storytelling, sold on Amazon and Shopify.

- [Claim checker](https://knght.com/check/): paste an ad, label or headline and see which words Ontario regulators (CPSO, RCDSO, Law Society, AGCO, CFIA) or the Competition Act are likely to question, with a safer way to say it. Free, runs in the browser.
- [Reply scribe](https://knght.com/reply/): paste a Google review, pick the stars and your category, and get a reply that thanks the reviewer, takes it offline and never confirms they were a patient or client. Flags risky edits live. Free, runs in the browser.
- [Licence keep](https://knght.com/keep/): list licence, registration, insurance and domain renewal dates and download a calendar file with reminders 90, 30 and 7 days ahead. Free, runs in the browser.
- [The herald](https://knght.com/herald/): make print-ready QR code signs for Google reviews, booking, guest Wi-Fi and contact cards. The link goes straight into the code, with no redirect or sign-up, so it never expires. Tests the code before you print. Free, runs in the browser.
- [Can your clinic put patient information into ChatGPT?](https://knght.com/rules/clinics-ai-and-patient-information/): PHIPA and AI tools for Ontario clinics, in plain language.
- [Real estate teams and the brokerage name](https://knght.com/rules/real-estate-teams-and-the-brokerage-name/): RECO advertising rules for real estate teams under TRESA: brokerage name, team names, sold stories and awards.
- [What a brand world costs in Ontario](https://knght.com/rules/what-a-brand-world-costs-in-ontario/): published price ranges for branding, websites and retainers in Toronto and the GTA, and how KNGHT prices the Verdict and the Build.
- [Your sigil](https://knght.com/sigil/): a free tool that forges a black and white crest for a business from its name, category and the one thing it guards.
- [Book a free call](https://knght.com/book/): a free 30-minute call. Leave with your three biggest risks, one fix for this week, and a straight answer on fit.
- [Score your world](https://knght.com/#score): a seven-question self-check that scores a brand out of 70 and names its weakest layer.
